title: Brushing back in time!
description: Adds some cool new archaeological features!
body:
Adds some new archaeological features that WILL make you want to explore more your world.
Archaeology Table:
A professoin block that turns a villiger into an archaeologist,crafted with any planks a brush and a book.



Hardened Soaked Sand:
A block that you can crack and brush with a tool that i will explian about later, is an uncraftable block, generates in deep cold oceans, deep lukewarm oceans and deep oceans.



Petrified Gravel:
Another block that you can crack and brush, is an ucraftable block too, generates in deep cold oceans, deep lukewarm oceans and deep oceans.


Soaked Sand:
a block that you create by Right Clicking sand with a water bottle, is an uncraftable block, doesn't generates naturally.


Treasured Sand:
a block that created by putting Soaked Sand on a block and under the block putting a Pointed Dripstone.


Strainer:
an item that if you Right Click with it on Treasured Sand you get 5 Gold Nuggets and 7 Sand Dust (another item that i will explain about later), crafted with two planks and one string, can't be found in chests.


Cracker And Brush:
an item that let you crack and brush Hardened Soaked Sand and Petrified Gravel to get the items that are in them, crafted with a brush and a stone pickaxe, can't be found in chests.


Rusty Clockwork Gear:
an item that you get if you crack and brush Hardened Soaked Sand, is an uncraftable item, can't be found in chests.


Chronos Shard:
an item that you get if you crack and brush Petrified Gravel, is an uncraftable item, can't be found in chests.


Sand Dust:
an item that you can throw on entities to give them blindness for 10 seconds, is an ucraftable item, can't be found in chests.


Time Controller:
an item that can freeze and unfreeze time! crafted with 4 Gold Blocks 4 Rusty Clockwork Gear and 1 Chronos Shard, can't be found in chests.


Archaeologist:
a villiger professoin that you can sell and buy items from him, doesn't spawn naturally.
